objects.name: a writing desk with a locked drawer
a camel-hair overcoat on a hook
a folded stack of evening papers

people.name: Giuseppe Lanza
people.role: a shipping clerk who had come into money

people.name: Rutherford Bidwell
people.role: a bookmaker in a small way

secret.description: Rutherford Bidwell hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 8:00 PM.
Assunta Grasso is with Wilhelm Brauer in the Service Stairs from 9:30 PM to 10:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Marion Ellery drinks alone in the Bar from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

people.name: Maureen Corrigan
people.role: a photographer for the rotogravure section
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Maureen Corrigan is alone with Giuseppe Lanza in the Roof Garden from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and kills Giuseppe Lanza at 8:00 PM.

coverSecret.description: Maureen Corrigan drinks alone in the Bar from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

secret.description: Wilhelm Brauer is with Assunta Grasso in the Service Stairs from 9:30 PM to 10:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Edith Winslow meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 6:30 PM and asks for money.

method.name: strangling with a cord
method.bodyEvidence: A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.

environment.radioContent: a serial about a lost heiress
environment.radioOutcome: the episode ended with the lawyer arrested, not the brother

Giuseppe Lanza was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 7:30 PM and 8:00 PM. A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.
A length of sash cord is missing from the Kitchen. A cut end of the same hemp is still tied to the fitting it was taken from.
Rain began at 10:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Chandler Thorndike says the bar radio carried a serial about a lost heiress at 7:30 PM, and that the episode ended with the lawyer arrested, not the brother. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Found in the Front Desk: A draft codicil in Giuseppe Lanza's hand striking Assunta Grasso out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Chandler Thorndike says Giuseppe Lanza told Assunta Grasso the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A subpoena naming Giuseppe Lanza as a witness before the grand jury, with Maureen Corrigan's name written in the margin.
Edith Winslow says Giuseppe Lanza said to Maureen Corrigan that a man who testifies sleeps better.
